title: Company, Eternal Concept Art
project: Company, Eternal — a frost dieselpunk western set in Freeland
credit: Concept art for Company, Eternal, art-directed by Brian MacAdam; images produced with AI assistance.
_notes: Names marked unconfirmed are placeholders; confirm before publishing. The White Werebear image was cropped to remove a fake AI-generated signature in the bottom-right corner.

items.name: The Wendigo
items.caption: Antlered skull, black feathers, red eyes.
items.description: A pixel-art take on the wendigo that guards the way to Verdant Nook: a bird-skull face under antlers, a ribcage showing through matted black feathers, and trophies strung at the waist.

items.name: White Werebear
items.caption: Scarred, hulking, and waiting in its den.
items.description: A white bear built like a wrestler, with old claw scars across its face and shoulder, set in a snowstorm.

items.name: Gunslinger
items.caption: Long coat, purple bandana, white hair.
items.description: A masked rider in a long black coat with a purple lining, a red pinstripe vest and a gold buckle.

items.name: Gunslinger — sprite sheet
items.caption: The same character, translated into game sprites.
items.description: The turnaround carried into in-game pixel sprites, with walk cycles facing front, side and back.

items.name: Cast lineup
items.caption: Eight figures from the frozen frontier.
items.description: A lineup of chibi-proportioned characters: frontier settlers in fur-trimmed coats, a lantern-carrying vampire, and turned miners with picks, shovels and headlamps.
